questions.stem: A 50-year-old male underwent heart surgery for the prosthetic valve. Post-surgery he was started on warfarin therapy to prevent thromboembolic episodes. Which of the following statement is TRUE?

options.label: A
options.text: Sulphonamide displaces warfarin from the plasma protein binding site and increases the free drug concentration

options.label: B
options.text: Dose of warfarin to be reduced when administered along with barbiturates

options.label: C
options.text: Oral contraceptives decrease the clotting factors

options.label: D
options.text: Cimetidine induces the warfarin metabolism

questions.answerText: Sulphonamide displaces warfarin from the plasma protein binding site and increases the free drug concentration
questions.solutionHtml:
Sulphonamide displaces warfarin from the plasma protein binding site and increases the free drug concentration

Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 670

questions.stem: The physician prescribed cotrimoxazole for an infant suffering from pneumonia. After 4 days of therapy, the infant turned yellowish and elevated unconjugated bilirubin levels(25mg/dl). Which one of the following is TRUE?

options.label: A
options.text: It's a typical case of physiological jaundice, no intervention is needed

options.label: B
options.text: Cotrimoxazole displaced bilirubin from the plasma protein binding site and precipitated kernicterus

options.label: C
options.text: Cotrimoxazole inhibits the excretion of bilirubin through the kidney and caused jaundice

options.label: D
options.text: Cotrimoxazole elevates the bilirubin level by inducing the enzymes in the liver

questions.answerText: Cotrimoxazole displaced bilirubin from the plasma protein binding site and precipitated kernicterus
questions.solutionHtml:
Cotrimoxazole displaced bilirubin from the plasma protein binding site and precipitated kernicterus

Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 757

questions.stem: 25-year-old pregnant woman in 1st trimester was suffering from venous thromboembolism and the treating doctor is planning to put her anticoagulant. Which of the following anticoagulant is safe in pregnancy?

options.label: A
options.text: Heparin

options.label: B
options.text: Warfarin

options.label: C
options.text: Nicoumalone

options.label: D
options.text: Rivaroxaban

questions.solutionHtml:
Heparin

Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:664

questions.stem: Capillary endothelial cells in the brain have tight junctions called blood-brain barrier (BBB). BBB limits the entry of drugs. Which of the following is FALSE regarding drug penetration into the brain and CSF?

options.label: A
options.text: Streptomycin is lipid insoluble and cannot cross BBB

options.label: B
options.text: P-gp present in the brain extrude many drugs that enter

options.label: C
options.text: Dopamine crosses BBB and is used in Parkinsonism

options.label: D
options.text: Meningitis increases the permeability of BBB

questions.answerText: Dopamine crosses BBB and is used in Parkinsonism
questions.solutionHtml:
Dopamine crosses BBB and is used in Parkinsonism

Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:24 &25

questions.stem: Among the following options, which one is false about plasma protein binding of drugs:

options.label: A
options.text: Acidic drugs bind to albumin and basic drugs to alpha 1 acid glycoprotein

options.label: B
options.text: Free drug has high Vd

options.label: C
options.text: Highly protein-bound drugs may be removed by dialysis

options.label: D
options.text: Protein-bound drugs may undergo displacement reactions

questions.answerText: Highly protein-bound drugs may be removed by dialysis
questions.solutionHtml:
Highly protein-bound drugs may be removed by dialysis

Acidic drugs bind to albumin and basic drugs to alpha 1 acid glycoprotein



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 26
